audit_population.unit: every declaration in the frozen parent closure whose conclusion head is recognized as a class by baseline HomeIndex

representation.field_contract: an explicit JSON boolean for every row, computed from Lean.Meta.isInstanceCore in the imported historical environment
representation.reason: constant kind cannot distinguish an ordinary theorem concluding a class-valued proposition from a theorem registered as an instance

policy_ablation.rule: a class-producing declaration remains refused unless its own row explicitly carries is_instance=false; true and missing metadata remain conservative refusals

required_measurements: class-producing declarations by constant kind and registered-instance status
registered instances newly judged by the ablation
non-instance class-valued declarations newly judged by the ablation
candidate-bearing binder events and class-pair families among those declarations
historical extraction time, row count, parse errors, and memory

acceptance.representation: accept only if the exact historical extractor compiles, every refreshed row has a boolean, and the instance oracle has no unknowns
acceptance.safety: accept the option-gated policy split only if zero rows marked is_instance=true enter candidate generation
acceptance.positive: finite_basis must propose Semiring exactly and its already-verified child proof remains the kernel certificate
acceptance.default_activation: not authorized by this audit regardless of outcome; proof precision requires a separately frozen control population

claim_boundary: a post-hoc structural policy audit on one historical closure, not detector recall and not proposal precision
